scope: Selection-only replay of v1 after discrete held action loss tied early while a fitting b-failure state was not yet learned. V1 sequential Train gate remains failed and no Dev was run. New rule is registered before replay or later actual Train outcomes. Preserve all budgets, data, batches, seeds and final tensor hashes; only selected epochs may change.
innerGate: Lexicographic selection: first minimize held family-balanced action-target loss (tolerance 1e-10), then minimize held family/benchmark-balanced continuous critic loss (smooth L1 plus the same rank weight). Earlier epoch only if both tie. All seeds must still improve action-target loss over parent without worsening either benchmark or false handoffs. No training-family loss or downstream outcomes select epochs.
refitGate: Refit all Train with identical full-control draws and each fixed inner-selected epoch; preserve all 40 epochs, final weights and optimizer. Refit cached target non-regression is diagnostic, not an eligibility filter in this new protocol. Require frozen prior and exact normal-state output preservation in all candidates.
nextStage: After all inner gates, evaluate parent, full-refit seeds 42/43/44, and failure-aware checklist on original 514 Train episodes with four common new response draws (seed 617) and extra no-dropout retail. Every trained seed must improve at least one actual benchmark total versus parent, worsen neither generated nor retail totals, parameters/state/evidence, false handoffs or resolved-field requests, and retain no-dropout necessary requests and recovery. Baseline holds only when expected-loss ordering lacks an observed failed mandatory field, cannot hand off or retrieve, and that channel cannot be queried again; otherwise uses the existing checklist. Baseline comparison is required evidence, not assumed weaker.
devGate: Only if actual Train gates pass: freeze fixed refit/42 and all three seeds, evaluate original generated Dev and 16 shared retail response masks plus public document retention. All seeds must worsen no parent economic total/parameter/state/evidence/safety metric and improve at least one actual total; retain no-dropout required requests/recovery. Compare the failure-aware checklist. No selection of another seed or epoch from Dev. If performance matches the checklist, do not claim an extra benefit of learned values. No Test or frozen 27-source holdout inference.
